About the artist · Mumbai, India

A classical foundation, a voice of her own.

Monika Nirala is a vocalist and performer with 6–7 years of formal Hindustani classical training. Her musical interests span classical, light music, folk, Bollywood, ghazal and Western vocals.

Alongside her formal training, she has taken part in university and national-level music competitions and performed across varied platforms. Her original song “Saanware” brings songwriting, composition, vocal performance and on-screen storytelling together in one project.

“Music is not just what I do, it’s who I am.”
